protected_invariants: No alteration of frozen protocol, candidate, historical receipts, holdout-consumption history, scope authority, production readiness or activation.
Reject precision-lossy temporal evidence; preserve all representable existing timestamp, feature order, numeric formulas and error-class behavior.
Production protocol Git ancestry and hash binding must remain fail-closed; test fixtures must not reinterpret historical freeze identity.
Use real dependency implementations outside deliberately isolated negative tests. Existing no-write and no-fit safeguards remain effective.
Extend existing canonical validation profiles; never remove/skip tests, lower assertions, introduce a parallel CI, change review/merge authority or silently mask failure.
forbidden_side_effects: No football/odds provider contact, quota consumption, acquisition, business DB/raw writes, migration, real-data training, prediction, backtest, activation or production operations.
No reading/logging/copying credential values or mutating historical evidence.
No merge, release, force push or edits to existing user worktrees.
